scenarios.source: ANUGA (Geoscience Australia / ANU, GPL); GEM-15 / Copernicus GLO-30; ESA WorldCover 2021
scenarios.method: ANUGA 4.2.0 2D shallow-water (DE0, compute mode gpu, GPU offload) dam → 120 km cap (257 km², 158922 triangles, uniform ≤ 2500 m²). DEM: gem15 30 m, path cells lowered 2 m. Manning n from WorldCover fractions. Triangular release at the crest outlet: V = 5 Mm³ over 12 h, peak 231 m³/s at 0.3 D (screening values, not tied to any event). Dry start, free outflow, 54 h simulated. Wet = max depth > 0.1 m. Grid: flood/hand_grid.json. maxdepth/frames uint8 depth = value/255 × 8 m; arrival.png 0 = not reached, else hours = value × 0.2. Frames every 30 min.
scenarios.uncertainty: Scenario exploration, not a forecast. 30 m terrain without channel bathymetry; no calibration data; the release hydrograph is an assumption, not a breach model. Arrival times are mesh-sensitive (see test E4): show them as a range. Mass balance error 1.87e-11 % of V.
scenarios.label: 5 Mm³ over 12 h (screening scenario, not tied to any event)
